Month 1: Foundation & Authentication

1.1 User Authentication & Registration
What: Allow users to securely authenticate and access testing.
AI Approach: JWT auth with bcrypt; httpOnly cookie sessions
How it works:
  - User submits form with client-side validation
  - Server validates credentials and sets secure session cookie
  - Protected routes redirect unauthenticated users to login
  - Session refresh runs silently before expiry
Files: New src/services/user-authentication-registrationService.ts, update src/index.ts
Cost: $0
Impact: HIGH - Core feature for testing
